reasons.correctness: createTicket publishes SupportTicketCreatedEvent through ApplicationEventPublisher and no longer calls EmailService. The listener sends the confirmation in the AFTER_COMMIT phase. Interface names and the constructor match. Build is green; hidden tests 3/3 pass.
reasons.convention_fit: Event and listener live in support/ticket/event. The listener uses @RequiredArgsConstructor with private final fields, @TransactionalEventListener(AFTER_COMMIT), and catch-and-log. It follows the structure of InvoiceCreatedEventListener, which the agent read first.
reasons.design_fit: Reuses Spring's event mechanism the way subscription/event already does. Adds one constructor parameter. EmailService stays in the service only for the admin-response path. Small footprint, no duplicated logic.
reasons.test_quality: SupportTicketCreatedEventListenerUnitTest covers the send and the swallowed failure, but the failure test asserts nothing beyond not throwing. The service test verifies the published event but not its language field. The integration test was adapted to never().
reasons.graph_use: Graph queries located the support/ticket package and the existing */event/ listeners before editing. The agent then read InvoiceCreatedEvent and InvoiceCreatedEventListener and mirrored their structure in the new files.
